sessions.phase_label: Interior illustration, formatting, and publication-package planning

requirements.title: Manuscript Copyediting
requirements.definition: Polish the manuscript's grammar, punctuation, wording, flow, repetition, and narrative clarity while preserving the author's intended meaning and voice.
requirements.boundary_note: Specific sentence rewrites and punctuation corrections are attributes and instances of the same copyediting mechanism. Dedication content, source-file fidelity, and visual formatting can fail or change independently and are excluded.

requirements.title: Authoritative Manuscript Version Fidelity
requirements.definition: Use the client-designated current manuscript file and preserve the client's accepted or newly supplied content when producing later formatted versions.
requirements.boundary_note: This concerns version and content preservation rather than the linguistic quality of the edits; the latest content can be omitted even when copyediting itself is satisfactory.

requirements.title: Chapter Illustrations
requirements.definition: Include suitable illustrations at chapter openings with client-approved placement, dimensions, visual consistency, and acceptable rendering quality.
requirements.boundary_note: Image source, chapter assignment, full-page placement, palette suitability, cropping, distortion, corner treatment, and pixelation are attributes of one illustration mechanism. The exterior cover is independently designed and excluded.

requirements.title: Interior Page Layout
requirements.definition: Format the paperback interior using the selected trim size and an acceptable page-density, spacing, and body-text layout.
requirements.boundary_note: Trim size, paragraph spacing, page density, and body-text layout are coupled parameters of the interior layout. Chapter images, headings, front-matter pages, and navigation elements have independent acceptance criteria and remain separate.

requirements.title: Title and Chapter Heading Typography
requirements.definition: Render the book title, chapter titles, subtitles, and recurring callout headings with correct text, hierarchy, capitalization, and typography.
requirements.boundary_note: This Requirement covers heading-specific hierarchy and typography, including title artifacts and callout styling. General paragraph spacing and page layout are independently changeable and excluded.

requirements.title: Page Numbering and Table of Contents
requirements.definition: Add page numbers and maintain a correctly formatted table of contents whose entries correspond to the finalized interior pagination and chapter structure.
requirements.boundary_note: Page numbering and table-of-contents page references form one coupled navigation mechanism because final pagination determines the listed page numbers. Heading appearance remains separate.

requirements.title: Interior Title Page Layout
requirements.definition: Format the interior title page with the intended title, subtitle, author name, and accepted ordering and emphasis.
requirements.boundary_note: The interior title page is distinct from the exterior cover and from the copyright page; each can be revised or accepted independently.

requirements.title: Dedication Page Content
requirements.definition: Include the client's current dedication text and preserve the requested paragraph, line, and punctuation edits on the dedication page.
requirements.boundary_note: The dedication has its own missing-page and content-revision trajectory, so it is separate from general manuscript copyediting. The precise target of some late deletion requests still requires contextual verification.

requirements.title: Copyright Page Content and Layout
requirements.definition: Maintain the copyright page with accepted alignment and current publication, contact, website, and ISBN information.
requirements.boundary_note: Publisher wording, email, future website inclusion, ISBN placement, and alignment are fields of one copyright-page mechanism rather than separate Requirements. General copyright-registration advice is excluded because it does not itself alter the book artifact.

requirements.title: Paperback Cover Design
requirements.definition: Produce a paperback cover suitable for the selected book dimensions and containing the required exterior title and publication details.
requirements.boundary_note: This Requirement concerns the exterior cover artifact, not the interior title page or chapter illustrations. Cover dimensions and spine-related sizing are parameters of the same cover mechanism.

requirements.title: Back Matter and Author Copy
requirements.definition: Prepare the requested back matter or back-cover copy together with concise author information for the publication package.
requirements.boundary_note: Back matter and author lines were offered and requested as one content-writing deliverable. The evidence does not fully resolve whether 'back content' means interior back matter, exterior back-cover copy, or both.

requirements.title: KDP Listing Metadata
requirements.definition: Prepare the keywords and other copyable listing content needed to create the book's KDP publication listing.
requirements.boundary_note: Metadata preparation has its own output and acceptance criterion and can be completed independently of operating or troubleshooting the KDP upload workflow.

requirements.title: KDP Upload Guidance
requirements.definition: Guide the client through uploading the paperback to KDP and provide assistance if the client becomes stuck during the process.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an independently requested operational service with a concrete publication outcome. Scheduling and call availability are project-management details and are excluded.

unresolved_candidates.description: The terms 'back matter' and 'back content' may refer to interior back matter, exterior back-cover copy, or both; the supplied text does not safely resolve the artifact boundary.

Attachment context is unavailable, so it is uncertain whether the requests to delete the final lines, final paragraph, and quotation marks all target the dedication page or another manuscript section.
